```text
# #2380: Patch: the AI prices a Dormant unit by the unit it wakes as
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

Some new cards arrive asleep and wake a few turns later as a big unit. Imprisoned Cosmality, for example, costs 2 mana and wakes as a 10/6. To the practice AI a sleeping unit is worth nothing until it wakes. So the AI almost never plays these cards itself, and it doesn't prepare for the player's. Once this is built, the AI values a sleeping unit by what it will become, less the longer it has to wait. It plays these cards on curve and takes the player's seriously.

## Why

- `material()` (`crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs:453-458`) sums `unit_worth` over `active_units_of` only, and that leaves a Dormant card out (R1839000: "It is no Unit … the AI's evaluation and its lethal solver").
- That choice was made before any Dormant card shipped:
  - R1839000 says "No shipped card is Dormant yet".
  - The AI test file's header says the same (`crates/ai/tests/ai/slumber.rs:7-8`).
  - The test pins "Its own Dormant card counts for nothing either, until it wakes" (`slumber.rs:95-117`).
- The latest sweep of record (`training/history/sweep-2026-10-29-2.md`) shows how rarely the AI plays these cards:

| Card | Easy: affordable turns / plays | Hard: affordable turns / plays |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Imprisoned Cosmality (`stinkyscape-019`) | 64 / 3 | 110 / 1 |
| Imprisoned Ship Smith (`stinkyscape-017`) | 46 / 1 | 41 / 2 |
| Spacemine (a 2-cost unit), for comparison | 30 / 14 | 35 / 12 |

- A Dormant card's status and countdown are on both seats' views (`UnitView.slumber`, R185), so pricing it uses no hidden information.

## Proposal

- In `material()`, add a term for each Dormant card on the side (`units_on_field_of` keeps them): the `unit_worth` of the card awake, times a named discount for each turn left on its countdown.
- A card that waits for an effect to wake it, with no countdown, counts at a named share.
- The weights are named in `EvalWeights` and `AI_EVAL`. `GREEDY_EVAL` keeps 0, since it is frozen.
- Nothing else changes:
  - `legal_actions` still never offers an action through or onto a Dormant card;
  - the face-threat and lethal reads still ignore it until it wakes.
- A new ruling amends R1839000's sentence on the AI's evaluation.

## Where it lands

- AI: `crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs`, `crates/ai/src/config.rs`, `crates/ai/tests/ai/slumber.rs` (the pinned test is rewritten under the new ruling), `crates/ai/README.md`.
- Spec: `spec/rulings/R1839000.md`, a new ruling note, `spec/pending/<issue>.md`. SPEC §6.1 (Dormant) and §9's practice AI.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Tests named after the new ruling:
  - the AI's own Dormant card scores above an empty zone, and an enemy one scores below it from the AI's side;
  - fewer turns left is worth more.
- [ ] With 2 mana and Imprisoned Cosmality its only play, `decide` plays it at Medium and Hard (today it ends the turn).
- [ ] Positions that differ only in a hidden card still give the same decision, and `GREEDY_EVAL` is unchanged.
- [ ] `cargo jackioh gate` passes at smoke size, and the PR reports a `sweep` of `stinkyscape-017` and `stinkyscape-019` next to the numbers above.
- [ ] `cargo jackioh spec check` passes.

## Size and risks

Hard (AI work by CLAUDE.md rule 11): about 7 files, 150 to 250 lines.

- The weights start untuned, as #1886's training-lane starts did. A small gate screen may not see a change confined to two cards.
- Any change to the evaluation can re-deal the seeded fixtures in the shadow-ban tests.
- The Dormant Starship hull in the backrow is still priced by its printed cost however many pieces have fused into it (`evaluate.rs:490-498`). That is left for a follow-up.
```

## Goal

The AI's evaluation (`material()`, `crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs`) counts each Dormant card on the field (§6.1,
R1839000) at the `unit_worth` of the same card awake, times `slumber_turn_share` per turn left on its countdown,
or `slumber_waiting_share` when it has none: two new `EvalWeights` fields, 0.5 in `AI_EVAL`, 0.0 in the frozen
`GREEDY_EVAL`. `legal_actions`, `face_threat` and the lethal solver are untouched. New ruling R2380000 amends
R1839000, §6.1 and §9.9. Tests named after it prove every acceptance item; the gate smoke passes; the final
report gives a sweep of `stinkyscape-017` and `stinkyscape-019` beside the issue's numbers.

## Files to touch

| File | | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `crates/ai/src/config.rs` | change | `EvalWeights`: `slumber_turn_share`, `slumber_waiting_share`; values in `AI_EVAL` and `GREEDY_EVAL` |
| `crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs` | change | imports; new `fn slumber_worth`; `material()`'s unit loop |
| `crates/ai/tests/ai/slumber.rs` | change | header; pinned R1839000 eval test rewritten; helpers; six `r2380000_…` tests |
| `crates/ai/tests/ai/starship.rs` | change | one stale comment (line 176) |
| `crates/ai/README.md` | change | one sentence (line 73) |
| `spec/rulings/R2380000.md` | new | the ruling |
| `spec/pending/2380.md` | new | its §11 paragraph |
| `spec/rulings/R1839000.md` | change | two sentences on the AI |
| `spec/06-keywords.md` | change | §6.1 Dormant row, one phrase |
| `spec/09-architecture.md` | change | §9.9 Evaluation bullet, one sentence |

Do not touch `crates/engine`, `crates/cards` (no patch fragment: an AI-only change claims no card, as #2376's
did not), `crates/ai/generation.json`, `crates/ai/src/shadow_ban.rs`, `training/history/`, `spec/INDEX.md`,
`spec/11-rulings.md`, any other weight, or `.github/`, `.harness/`, `bot/`. Governing: §6.1 Dormant, §9.9,
R1839000, R1839001, R185, R2249000.

## Steps

1. **`crates/ai/src/config.rs`, `struct EvalWeights`**, right after `pub dormant_card: f64,` (line 405):
   ```rust
       /// R2380000: the share of its awake `unit_worth` a Dormant card on the field (§6.1, R1839000)
       /// keeps per turn left on its countdown, so one that wakes in n of its controller's turns counts
       /// this to the power n of what it will be.
       pub slumber_turn_share: f64,
       /// R2380000: the share of its awake `unit_worth` a Dormant card with no countdown counts, one
       /// that waits for an effect to wake it (the Dormant Starship's launch).
       pub slumber_waiting_share: f64,
   ```
2. **Same file.** In `AI_EVAL`, right after its `dormant_card: 0.0,` (line 536):
   ```rust
       // R2380000: untuned starts for the training lanes, as #1886's are. A turn's wait at half, so
       // "Dormant for 2 turns" counts a quarter of the unit it wakes as; an effect's wake at half too.
       slumber_turn_share: 0.5,
       slumber_waiting_share: 0.5,
   ```
   In `GREEDY_EVAL`, right after its `dormant_card: 0.0,` (line 714):
   ```rust
       // R2380000's Dormant cards came after the gates were fixed too: nothing, as it gave them.
       slumber_turn_share: 0.0,
       slumber_waiting_share: 0.0,
   ```
   The literals in `crates/ai/tests/ai/evaluate.rs` end in `..AI_EVAL` and need nothing.
3. **`crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs`**: add `Slumber` and `units_on_field_of` to the `use jackioh_engine::{…}` list
   (lines 30-39).
4. **Same file**, a new function right after `fn dormant_worth` (before `/// A hero's side of the ledger`):
   ```rust
   /// R2380000: what a Dormant card on the field (§6.1, R1839000) is worth: the `unit_worth` of the same
   /// card awake, `slumber_turn_share` for each turn left on its countdown, or `slumber_waiting_share`
   /// when it has none and waits for an effect (no call at a zero share). Its status and countdown are
   /// on both seats' views (R185), so the seat prices its enemy's alike.
   fn slumber_worth(state: &GameState, unit: &CardInstance, slumber: &Slumber, w: &EvalWeights) -> f64 {
       let share = match slumber.turns {
           Some(turns) => w.slumber_turn_share.powi(turns.max(0)),
           None => w.slumber_waiting_share,
       };
       if share == 0.0 {
           return 0.0;
       }
       let mut awake = unit.clone();
       awake.slumber = None;
       share * unit_worth(state, &awake, w)
   }
   ```
5. **Same file, `fn material`**: replace
   `for unit in active_units_of(state, player) { value += unit_worth(state, unit, w); }` with
   ```rust
       // R2380000: a Dormant card (R1839000) counts by the unit it wakes as, discounted by its wait.
       for unit in units_on_field_of(state, player) {
           value += match &unit.slumber {
               None => unit_worth(state, unit, w),
               Some(slumber) => slumber_worth(state, unit, slumber, w),
           };
       }
   ```
   `units_on_field_of` is `active_units_of` with the Dormant cards kept, same order, so a board with none, or
   any board at zero shares, sums exactly as before. Leave every other `active_units_of` in the file alone.
6. **`crates/ai/tests/ai/slumber.rs`.**
   - Header: replace "the evaluation counts it as no Unit and no threat until it wakes (`active_units_of`
     leaves it out)" with "it is no threat until it wakes (`active_units_of` leaves it out of `face_threat`);
     the evaluation prices it by the unit it wakes as, less for each turn it waits (R2380000)"; replace the
     paragraph "No shipped card is Dormant yet…" with "Most boards put a unit on the field to sleep by writing
     its status, as `slumber::start_slumber_on_field` would. The cards: Mr. Vanilla (core-008) 4/4, Tempo Timmy
     (core-011) 3/3 and Imprisoned Cosmality (stinkyscape-019), (2) 10/6 Pierce, Dormant for 2 turns."
   - Rename `r1839000_the_evaluation_counts_a_dormant_card_as_no_unit_and_no_threat_until_it_wakes` to
     `r1839000_a_dormant_card_is_no_threat_until_it_wakes`; keep its setup and two `face_threat` asserts, then
     only `assert!(eval(&dormant, &AI_EVAL) > eval(&awake, &AI_EVAL));`. Delete `gone`, the closure, the
     "as if its zone were empty" assert and the "Its own Dormant card counts for nothing" block.
   - Append:
   ```rust
   const COSMALITY: &str = "stinkyscape-019";

   /// The AI's evaluation of `state`, the enemy to swing next.
   fn eval(state: &GameState, w: &EvalWeights) -> f64 {
       evaluate(state, AI, NextSwing::Enemy, w)
   }

   /// `state` with `player`'s first unit on the field Dormant with `turns` left on its countdown (`None`:
   /// waiting for an effect), and what that unit is worth awake.
   fn asleep(state: &GameState, player: PlayerId, turns: Option<i32>) -> (GameState, f64) {
       let mut out = state.clone();
       let worth = unit_worth(state, active_units_of(state, player)[0], &AI_EVAL);
       let id = sleep(&mut out, player);
       find_instance_mut(&mut out, &id).expect("the unit").slumber = Some(Slumber { turns });
       (out, worth)
   }

   /// The AI's turn 3, its second (2 crystals), at `tier`'s handicap, Imprisoned Cosmality the one card
   /// in its hand and both boards empty; with `human_hand` the human's hidden hand.
   fn cosmality_on_curve(tier: Handicap, human_hand: &[&str]) -> GameState {
       register_cards();
       let mut state = scenario(json!({
           "seed": "ai-dormant-curve",
           "turn": 3,
           "p1": { "hand": [COSMALITY], "mana": 2, "library": LIBRARY },
           "p2": { "hand": human_hand, "library": LIBRARY },
       }))
       .state()
       .clone();
       state.players[AI].handicap = Some(tier);
       state
   }
   ```
   and six `#[test]`s. Below, `awake = board()`, `share = AI_EVAL.slumber_turn_share * AI_EVAL.slumber_turn_share`,
   `eval(x)` is `eval(x, &AI_EVAL)` unless named, and `a == b` on floats means `(a - b).abs() < 1e-9` with both
   values in the message:
   - `r2380000_an_own_dormant_card_scores_above_an_empty_zone_and_an_enemy_one_below_it`:
     `(own, worth) = asleep(&awake, AI, Some(2))`, `gone = emptied(&awake, AI)`: `eval(&own) > eval(&gone)` and
     `eval(&own) - eval(&gone) == share * worth`. Then `(theirs, worth) = asleep(&awake, HUMAN, Some(2))`,
     `gone = emptied(&awake, HUMAN)`: `eval(&theirs) < eval(&gone)` and `eval(&gone) - eval(&theirs) == share * worth`.
   - `r2380000_fewer_turns_left_is_worth_more`: `own(t) = eval(&asleep(&awake, AI, Some(t)).0)`:
     `own(1) > own(2)`, `own(2) > own(3)`; `theirs(t)` the same for `HUMAN`: `theirs(1) < theirs(2)`, `theirs(2) < theirs(3)`.
   - `r2380000_a_dormant_card_with_no_countdown_counts_at_the_waiting_share`: `(own, worth) = asleep(&awake, AI, None)`:
     `eval(&own) - eval(&emptied(&awake, AI)) == AI_EVAL.slumber_waiting_share * worth`.
   - `r2380000_greedy_eval_still_counts_a_dormant_card_as_nothing`: `assert_eq!` both `GREEDY_EVAL` shares to
     `0.0`; for `player` in `[AI, HUMAN]`, `turns` in `[Some(2), None]`: `assert_eq!` (exact) of
     `eval(&asleep(&awake, player, turns).0, &GREEDY_EVAL)` and `eval(&emptied(&awake, player), &GREEDY_EVAL)`.
   - `r2380000_decide_plays_imprisoned_cosmality_on_curve_at_medium_and_hard`: for `tier` in
     `[AI_DIFFICULTY.medium, AI_DIFFICULTY.hard]`, `state = cosmality_on_curve(tier, &["core-011"])`,
     `cosmality = state.players[AI].hand[0].id.clone()`; for `cursor` in `0..2`: `decision = decide(&state, AI,
     &mut AiOptions::new(create_rng("ai-dormant-curve", cursor))).expect("a decision")`; assert
     `matches!(&decision.action, ActionBody::Play { instance_id, .. } if *instance_id == cosmality)`.
   - `r2380000_positions_that_differ_only_in_a_hidden_card_give_the_same_decision`: `decide_on(s)` is
     `decide(s, AI, &mut AiOptions::new(create_rng("ai-dormant-hidden", 0))).expect("a decision")`. (a) `first =
     asleep(&asleep(&board(), AI, Some(1)).0, HUMAN, Some(2)).0`; `second` = its clone with
     `second.players[HUMAN].hand[0].def_id = "core-008".to_string()`. (b) `first = cosmality_on_curve(AI_DIFFICULTY.hard,
     &["core-011"])`, `second` the same with `&["core-008"]`. For each pair: `assert_ne!` of their `hash_state`s,
     `assert_eq!` of their `decide_on`. Keep both hands one size: the count is public (a 1-card against a 2-card
     hand scored differently in the planner's run).
7. **`crates/ai/tests/ai/starship.rs`, line 176**: "The Dormant Starship is no Unit to the evaluation, and" →

## Tests

`crates/ai/tests/ai/slumber.rs` (step 6):

```
cargo test -p jackioh-ai --test ai slumber      # the file's 10 tests
cargo test -p jackioh-ai --test ai r2380000     # the six new ones
cargo test -p jackioh-ai                        # the whole crate, ~6.5 min
```

The planner built this change on a copy of `8e04d4897`: all three passed, fmt, clippy (`-p jackioh-ai`) and
`spec check` were clean, and `cargo jackioh gate` passed (20/20, 13/20 with 10 needed, 20/20). With both
`AI_EVAL` shares at 0.0 the Cosmality test fails on `EndTurn`.

## Done when

- [ ] Steps 1-13 done; the three commands above pass.
- [ ] The harness's checks: rustfmt, rulings (`spec check`), clippy (workspace), cargo tests (workspace).
- [ ] `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims` passes with no fragment.
- [ ] `cargo jackioh gate` passes at smoke size; its three result lines go in the final report.
- [ ] `cargo jackioh sweep stinkyscape-017 stinkyscape-019` (pass 1, then pass 2 for those at risk; 15-30 min):
      its rows for both cards go in the final report beside the issue's table, each marked pass 1 or pass 2 (the
      issue's numbers are pass 2 rows). Do not commit the report or touch `shadow_ban.rs`.

## Risks

- **Seeded games that now play differently.** The sum is bit-identical on a board with no Dormant card, so only AI
  games where S #17, S #19 or a Dormant Starship reaches the field change: shadow-ban and tier fixtures, the gate
  smokes inside `cargo test`, server bot tests, web practice tests. If a seeded test fails, read why, never loosen
  an assert, and name it in the report (`crates/ai/README.md`, "Decks and the shadow ban": a fixture that needs a
  new deal changes its seed).
- **The frozen baseline.** `GREEDY_EVAL` stays bit-identical: both weights 0.0 and `slumber_worth` returns before
  `unit_worth`. A test pins it.
- **Hidden information (rule 7, R185).** Only field cards both seats see are read; never read a hand or library
  in the new code. A test pins it.
- **Out of scope.** `legal_actions`, `face_threat_with` and the lethal solver keep `active_units_of`. The Dormant
  Starship in the backrow now also counts its fused stats at `slumber_waiting_share` (`starship.rs` passes);
  repricing it is the issue's follow-up. Imprisoned Ship Smith (its worth is the Waraxe it summons on waking) may
  still go unplayed; report its sweep rows as they come.

## Open questions

None blocks the build. The 0.5 starts are untuned (the smoke gate may not see a two-card change); a person or
the training lanes may move them later.

````markdown
R1839000, §6.1 and §9.9. Tests named after it prove every acceptance item; the gate smoke passes; the final
report gives a sweep of `stinkyscape-017` and `stinkyscape-019` beside the issue's numbers.

   /// R2380000: what a Dormant card on the field (§6.1, R1839000) is worth: the `unit_worth` of the same
   /// card awake, `slumber_turn_share` for each turn left on its countdown, or `slumber_waiting_share`
   /// when it has none and waits for an effect (no call at a zero share). Its status and countdown are
   /// on both seats' views (R185), so the seat prices its enemy's alike.
   fn slumber_worth(state: &GameState, unit: &CardInstance, slumber: &Slumber, w: &EvalWeights) -> f64 {
       let share = match slumber.turns {
           Some(turns) => w.slumber_turn_share.powi(turns.max(0)),
           None => w.slumber_waiting_share,
       };
       if share == 0.0 {
           return 0.0;
       }
       let mut awake = unit.clone();
       awake.slumber = None;
       share * unit_worth(state, &awake, w)
   }
   ```

               None => unit_worth(state, unit, w),
               Some(slumber) => slumber_worth(state, unit, slumber, w),
           };
       }
````
